text: ひとの　こころを　よむ　のうりょくを　テレパス　という！

structure.jp: ひとの　こころを　よむ　のうりょくを
structure.en: the ability to read people's minds

patterns.name: 〜を〜という
patterns.span: のうりょくを　テレパス　という
patterns.explanation: AをBという gives the name of something: 'A is called B'. のうりょくを　テレパス　という = 'the ability is called telepathy'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ひとの　こころを　よむ　のうりょく
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes it. ひとの　こころを　よむ　のうりょく = 'the ability to read people's minds'.
